test_title: PYST 46: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Toffee-nosed

options.text: A person who thinks he is of a high social class and looks down on people of lower class
A solid, respectable and respected member of society
Continue to live at the same social standard we have lived at, even though we have money problems
A person who seems impolite/of low education at first, but who is usually of good character

solution:
The correct answer is A person who thinks he is of a high social class and looks down on people of lower class.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom 'Toffee-nosed' is 'A person who thinks he is of a high social class and looks down on people of lower class.'.
 
• Toffee-nosed: Pretentiously superior; snobbish.
 
 
• *Example: There is nothing to be "toffee-nosed" about: it is common sense so far as keeping an allotment is concerned.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 1.

 ​

Correct Sentence:__ *A person who thinks he is of a high social class and looks down on people of lower class.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__
